questions.stem: A 62-year-old lady presented to the outpatient medical department having complaints of joint pains and myalgias for three months. She also had a history of valve replacement ten years back and was known as Diabetic for six years, and has been taking oral hypoglycemics since then. On laboratory investigations, her serum calcium level was significantly elevated. Radiological investigations revealed bilateral nephrolithiasis which was asymptomatic. X-ray skull showed a pepper-pot appearance. What is the most likely diagnosis?
